grf.counter_reality: Release authority requires independently controlled exact artifact identity, and productive truth additionally requires proof of the actually mapped object on the accepted execution path.
grf.retained_mechanism: Source-controlled exact artifact authority plus mapped-object/runtime identity attestation and fail-closed receipt consistency.
grf.remaining_counter_reality: A correct wrapper remains bypassable unless deployment/service-parent routing and restart/rollback paths are proven non-bypassable.
